podcast.title: Influence of Electric Warrior
podcast.body: Lol Tolhurst, future bandmate of Robert Smith in The Cure, was also deeply impressed by T-Rex's *Electric Warrior* album and Mark Bowen. "So was his future bandmate, Law Tallhurst."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Surprising History of Glam Rock

xref.title: Influence of Electric Warrior
xref.body: As a young artist, Robert Smith was "completely besotted" by T-Rex's *Electric Warrior* album and Mark Bowen, an influence shared with his future bandmate, Lol Tolhurst. "A young Robert Smith, who would later from the cure, was completely besotted by Electric Warrior and Mark Bowen."
